common.tooLong: {{label}} is too long. At most {{max}} characters.
common.yourNameHelp: This is how the others on the wall see you. A first name or a pseudonym is enough.
common.toServer: Goes to the server of {{app}} in the EU. Everyone on the wall sees it.
common.toServerHidden: Goes to the server of {{app}} in the EU. The others see it only once the notes are revealed.

more.label: More
more.systemIsOn: Light or dark follows the system.

landing.tab: Everyone writes notes, an AI groups them
landing.claim: Everyone writes notes, an AI groups them.
landing.lede: One person creates a wall with a question and shares the link. Everyone writes their ideas on notes, hidden at first, then visible to all. At the press of a button an AI proposes groups with headings. Free, no account.
landing.ctaHint: No account needed. You ask a question and share the link.
landing.description: A wall is a question and a surface for notes. First everyone writes on their own, without reading the others’ notes. Then the facilitator reveals them and has the AI propose groups. The facilitator sees the proposal before it applies, and can take it back.

trust.account: No account, not even for the facilitator
trust.ai: According to Cloudflare, the AI stores nothing and does not learn from it

preview.label: Example: a wall that has been grouped
preview.caption: Sample data
preview.question: What slows us down?
preview.note1: Too many meetings without a result
preview.note4: Two ticket systems side by side

landing.howRoles: One person facilitates, everyone else comes in through the link.

open.title: 1. Ask a question and share the link
open.text: You create a wall with your question and share the link or its QR code. Whoever opens it types a first name or a pseudonym.

write.title: 2. Write, then reveal
write.text: Everyone writes their notes, hidden at first: nobody reads along until the facilitator reveals them.

arrange.title: 3. Let it group
arrange.text: At the press of a button the AI proposes groups with headings. The facilitator applies the proposal or discards it; grouping by hand always works. At the end everyone can save the wall as a Markdown file.

equal.title: Every idea counts the same
equal.text: Whoever writes hidden is not steered by the first idea in the room.

fast.title: Grouped, not pushed around
fast.text: The AI sorts what somebody would otherwise move by hand, note by note.

data.title: Sparing with data
data.text: No account, no e-mail address. A wall deletes itself 30 days after the last visit.

languages.title: German and English
languages.text: Each person chooses their own language. The AI writes its headings in the facilitator’s language.

cost.a: Nothing. {{app}} is a private, non-commercial project with no way to pay.

account.a: No. The link is the access: whoever has it can join the wall. So pass it on to your team only.

admin.a: The person who created the wall. With the facilitator link they take that right to a second device or share it with someone.

limits.a: Up to {{online}} people at once and up to {{notes}} notes on a wall. The AI groups a wall at most {{runs}} times in 24 hours; by hand it always works.

ai.q: What happens to the notes when they are grouped?
ai.a: The question and the texts of the notes go to Cloudflare Workers AI, the service the wall is hosted with anyway; names do not go with them. According to Cloudflare nothing is stored there and nothing is trained on them. The computing is not certain to happen in the EU. Whoever does not want that groups by hand.

where.a: At Cloudflare, stored in data centres in the EU. The encrypted connection ends at Cloudflare’s nearest location, also outside the EU.

howLong.q: How long does anything stay stored?
howLong.a: A wall deletes itself 30 days after the last visit. The facilitator can delete it at once.

tracking.a: No. No analytics scripts, no cookies, nothing from other servers. Your browser remembers the walls you were on and your name. This list stays on your device; your name goes to a wall only when you join it.

landing.closingTitle: Try it with a real question
landing.closingText: Create a wall and share the link with your team.
landing.notice: {{app}} is a private, non-commercial project. There is no promise of availability.

wall.revealed_other: Revealed: {{count}} notes are now there for everyone to see.

clock.paused_other: The clock is paused: {{count}} minutes left to write.

clock.stepPaused_other: The clock is paused: {{count}} minutes left in this step.

wall.eraseNotes_other: Your {{count}} notes stay on the wall, without your name: you can no longer change or delete them afterwards. If they should go, delete them first.

wall.erasedText: Your name is removed from the wall, and the wall is no longer in the list on this device. What you wrote stays on the wall, without your name.

guide.adminAloneEmpty: You facilitate: send the link to your team, then all of you write your ideas on notes.
guide.adminAloneNotes: You facilitate: send the link to your team, so everyone can write along.
guide.adminEmpty: You facilitate: now everyone writes their ideas on notes, you too.
guide.adminNotes: You facilitate: everyone keeps writing. What belongs together goes into a frame with “New group”.
guide.adminSorting: You facilitate: move together what belongs together, and give every group a name.
guide.adminSorted: You facilitate: every note lies in a named group. Keep writing if something is still missing.
guide.adminArrange: You facilitate: when everyone is done, “Group notes” proposes groups with headings. By hand works just as well: what belongs together goes into a frame with “New group”.
guide.adminArrangeRest: You facilitate: “Group notes” proposes groups for the notes that lie in no group made or renamed by hand. By hand works just as well: move together what belongs together.
guide.adminArrangedFresh: You facilitate: the AI has grouped the notes. If it does not fit, “Undo” takes it back at once. Otherwise move and rename whatever is not right.
guide.adminArranged: You facilitate: the AI has grouped the notes. Move and rename whatever is not right. The grouping can still be undone under “More”.
guide.memberAlone: Write your ideas on notes, and pass the link on if somebody is still missing.
guide.memberNotes: Write more ideas on notes. What belongs together goes into a frame with “New group”.
guide.memberSorting: Move together what belongs together, and give every group a name.
guide.memberSorted: Every note lies in a named group. Keep writing if something is still missing.
guide.adminHiddenAlone: You facilitate: send the link to your team. Everyone writes on their own, and nobody reads along until you reveal the notes.
guide.adminHiddenEmpty: You facilitate: now everyone writes their ideas on notes, you too. Nobody reads along until you reveal the notes.
guide.adminHiddenNotes: You facilitate: everyone writes on their own, nobody reads along. When everyone is done, “Reveal” shows every note to everyone.
guide.adminHiddenOver: You facilitate: nothing is locked, everyone can keep writing. Reveal the notes when everyone is done, or give five more minutes.
guide.memberHiddenAlone: Write your ideas on notes, and pass the link on if somebody is still missing. Nobody reads along until the facilitator reveals the notes.
guide.memberHidden: Write your ideas on notes. Nobody reads along until the facilitator reveals the notes.
guide.memberHiddenOver: You can keep writing until the facilitator reveals the notes.
guide.adminDiscuss: You facilitate: go through the groups together: what stands out, what is missing, what follows? Save the result as Markdown under “More”.
guide.memberDiscuss: Talk the groups through together: what stands out, what is missing, what follows?
guide.adminVote: You moderate: everyone gives their points on their own, you too, and presses “Cast vote”. Nobody sees who voted how. Once everyone has voted, “Count votes” shows the result to everyone at once.
guide.adminVoteCast: You moderate: your points are cast, and you can change them until the votes are counted. Once everyone has voted, “Count votes” shows the result to everyone at once.
guide.adminCounted: You moderate: the result stands, for everyone at once. “Next” leads to the next step; you can save it as Markdown under “More”.
guide.memberVote: Give your points to what matters most to you and press “Cast vote”. Nobody sees your points, only the result once the moderation counts.
guide.memberVoteCast: Your points are cast. You can change them until the moderation counts, and nobody sees them.
guide.memberCounted: The result stands: everyone sees the same ranking. What was counted are the points, not who gave them.
guide.adminEstimate: You moderate: everyone estimates on their own, you too, and presses “Cast vote”. Nobody sees who estimated what. When everyone has cast, “Count votes” shows everyone the median and the range at once.
guide.adminEstimateCast: You moderate: your estimate is cast, and you can change it until it is counted. When everyone has cast, “Count votes” shows everyone the median and the range at once.
guide.adminEstimated: You moderate: the median and the range are in, for everyone at once, without a single estimate. “Next” takes you to the next step.
guide.memberEstimate: Estimate on your own and press “Cast vote”. Nobody sees your number, only the median and the range once the moderation counts.
guide.memberEstimateCast: Your estimate is cast. You can change it until the moderation counts, and nobody sees it.
guide.memberEstimated: Everyone sees the same summary, no single estimate. What was counted are the numbers, not who estimated them.
guide.adminEstimateTalk: You moderate: talk about why the estimates differ. The reasons are on the wall without names. Then everyone estimates again.
guide.memberEstimateTalk: Talk about why the estimates differ: whoever knows something the others do not, says it. Then everyone estimates again.
guide.adminEstimateResult: You moderate: both rounds stand by the method. What follows from the number? You can save it as Markdown under “More”.
guide.memberEstimateResult: Both rounds stand by the method: median, middle half and range, no single estimate.
guide.adminTeam: You moderate: the app has formed the teams. Under “More” → “Teams” you find every team with its names, for your video tool's breakout rooms; you can also swap people there.
guide.memberTeam: Talk it over in your team and note down what counts. Only your team sees your notes, without names; in a pair it is easy to guess who wrote what.
guide.adminPresent: You moderate: call on the teams one after the other; each presents its core idea. All notes are now there for everyone, without names.
guide.memberPresent: Each team presents its core idea. All notes are now there for everyone, without names.
guide.adminBeforeTeams: You moderate: start the clock; then everyone thinks alone and writes, you too, and nobody reads along. When the time is up the app forms pairs and moves on by itself.
guide.memberBeforeTeams: Think alone and write your ideas on notes. Nobody reads along; afterwards you share them in a pair.

wall.adminLinkCopied: Facilitator link copied. Anyone who has it facilitates this wall and can delete it: share it only if someone should facilitate with you.

team.room: Talk in your video tool's breakout room {{n}}.
team.none: You are in no team yet: the app forms the teams from everyone on the wall right now.

teams.title: Teams
teams.text: Each number is a breakout room in your video tool. To swap, choose one person, then the one they swap with. Whoever moves keeps seeing what they saw.
teams.choosing: Who does {{name}} swap with? Choose the person in another team.
teams.said: Swapped. The teams are set anew.

auto.off: Wait for “Next” when the time is up
auto.on: Move on by itself when the time is up
auto.saidOff: This step waits for “Next” when the time is up.
auto.saidOn: This step moves on by itself when the time is up.

surface.label: Surface
surface.empty: “New note” puts a note on the surface. Everyone on the wall sees it at once.
surface.emptyHidden: “New note” puts a note on the surface. The others see it only once the notes are revealed.
surface.keys: Keys: the arrow keys go to the nearest note. G goes to the next group. Enter changes the text or the title, Delete deletes, M moves, V moves into a group, N writes a new note. Space selects a note, Shift with the arrow keys selects more, Esc clears the selection. Plus and minus zoom, 0 shows all.
surface.moving: Moving: the arrow keys move the note. Enter drops it, Esc cancels.
surface.movingSeveral: Moving: the arrow keys move the {{count}} notes. Enter drops them, Esc cancels.
surface.movingGroup: Moving: the arrow keys move the group with its notes, with Shift they change its size. Enter drops it, Esc cancels.
surface.moveCancelled: Moving cancelled. The note is back where it was.
surface.moveCancelledAll: Moving cancelled. Everything is back where it was.
surface.choosing: Selecting is on: a press on a note selects it, or takes it out again.

note.deleteText: “{{text}}” is deleted for everyone. This cannot be undone.

move.out_one: The note is now without a group.
move.out_other: {{count}} notes are now without a group.

group.title: Title of the group
group.titleHelp: At most {{max}} characters. The title may be missing.
group.deleteText_one: “{{title}}” is deleted for everyone. The note in it stays on the wall, without a group. This cannot be undone.
group.deleteText_other: “{{title}}” is deleted for everyone. The {{count}} notes in it stay on the wall, without a group. This cannot be undone.
group.deleteTextEmpty: “{{title}}” is deleted for everyone. There are no notes in it. This cannot be undone.
group.deletedNotes_one: Group deleted. Its note is now without a group.
group.deletedNotes_other: Group deleted. Its {{count}} notes are now without a group.
group.empty: No notes in this group yet.

list.label: List
list.empty: No notes yet. “New note” writes the first one, and everyone on the wall sees it at once.
list.emptyHidden: No notes of yours yet. “New note” writes the first one; the others see it only once the notes are revealed.

arrange.where: “Group notes” sends the question and the texts of the notes, without names, to Cloudflare’s AI service Workers AI: according to Cloudflare without storing them or training on them, but not certainly in the EU. More under <privacy>Privacy</privacy>.
arrange.whereNote: A new note goes to the server of {{app}} in the EU. Everyone on the wall sees it.
arrange.runningState_one: The AI is grouping 1 note. This usually takes less than half a minute.
arrange.runningState_other: The AI is grouping {{count}} notes. This usually takes less than half a minute.
arrange.cancelHint: “Cancel” only ends the waiting. The attempt still counts: a wall can be grouped {{runs}} times in 24 hours.
arrange.proposal: The AI’s proposal: {{groups}}. Only you see it.
arrange.proposalLoose: The AI’s proposal: {{groups}}, {{loose}} without a group. Only you see it.
arrange.partial: A part of the notes got no answer from the AI and lies without a group.
arrange.previewNote: “Apply” arranges the wall like this for everyone, “Discard” leaves it as it was. While the proposal stands you change nothing on the wall; the others keep working.
arrange.applyHint: “Apply” stores the arrangement on the server of {{app}} in the EU. Everyone on the wall sees it.
arrange.runsLeft_one: This wall can be grouped {{runs}} times in 24 hours, 1 more time now.
arrange.runsLeft_other: This wall can be grouped {{runs}} times in 24 hours, {{count}} more times now.
arrange.runsNone: This wall can be grouped {{runs}} times in 24 hours: that was the last time for now.
arrange.undoText: The notes then lie again where they lay before grouping, and the AI’s groups go. Groups that were renamed stay, with their notes. What was moved since is lost. This cannot be undone.
arrange.saidDiscarded: Proposal discarded. The wall is as it was.
arrange.whereKey: “Group notes” sends the question and the texts of the notes, without names, with your key straight from this browser to {{provider}}: {{facts}}. More under <privacy>Privacy</privacy>.
arrange.keyOn: “Group notes” asks {{provider}}, with your key. Remove it under “More”, and Cloudflare groups again.
arrange.runningStateKey_one: {{provider}} is grouping 1 note, with your key.
arrange.runningStateKey_other: {{provider}} is grouping {{count}} notes, with your key.
arrange.cancelHintKey: “Cancel” ends the requests to {{provider}}. {{provider}} may still bill your account for what was computed until then.
arrange.saidCancelledKey: Cancelled: the requests to {{provider}} have ended.

points.empty: Give at least one point, then press “Cast vote”.

choices.empty: Choose at least one option, then press “Cast vote”.

vote.omitted_one: 1 note is not up for the vote: a vote has at most 80 options. Group the notes, and all of them fit.
vote.omitted_other: {{count}} notes are not up for the vote: a vote has at most 80 options. Group the notes, and all of them fit.
vote.noOptions: There is nothing to choose: no note was on the wall when this step began.

how.dots_one: Counted by points: 1 point a person.
how.dots_other: Counted by points: {{count}} points a person.
how.approval_one: Counted by approval: 1 vote a person.
how.approval_other: Counted by approval: up to {{count}} votes a person.
how.rank_one: Counted by Borda: place 1 gets 1 point.
how.rank_other: Counted by Borda: place 1 gets {{count}} points, the last 1.
how.score_one: Counted as the mean of scores from 1 to 5.
how.score_other: Counted as the mean of scores from 1 to 5.

estimate.heading: Your estimate
estimate.stored: Cast: {{value}}. You can change it until it is counted.
estimate.fieldHelp: A number, such as 40 or 2.5. Enter casts it.
estimate.reasonHelp: Everyone sees it in the next step, without your name. Nobody sees your number.

problem.empty: Enter a number, then press “Cast vote”.
problem.notANumber: That is not a number. Use digits only, such as 40 or 2.5.
problem.tooLarge: This number is too large for an estimate.
problem.outside: This number lies outside what the estimate allows.

estimate.movedValue: median from {{from}} to {{to}}, middle half from {{widthFrom}} to {{widthTo}} wide
estimate.sentence_one: Median {{median}}, middle half {{q1}} to {{q3}}, range {{min}} to {{max}}, 1 estimate.
estimate.sentence_other: Median {{median}}, middle half {{q1}} to {{q3}}, range {{min}} to {{max}}, {{count}} estimates.
estimate.open: Not estimated yet. {{voted}} of {{of}} have estimated.
estimate.hint: Nobody sees your number, not even the moderation: everyone sees only the median and the range once it is counted.

reject.phaseBallot: The vote is counted already: your vote was not taken any more. The result is on the wall.
reject.staleBallot: The wall had moved on to the next step at the same moment: your vote was not taken.
reject.invalidTeams: These teams do not match the wall's teams: your swap was not taken. Try again.
reject.staleTeams: The teams changed at the same moment: your swap was not taken. “Teams” shows them as they are now.
reject.phaseTeams: The wall had moved to a step without teams at the same moment: your swap was not taken.
reject.notAuthorEdit: Only the person who wrote a note can change its text.
reject.notAuthorDelete: Only the person who wrote a note, or the facilitator, can delete it.
reject.notFound: This note no longer exists: somebody has deleted it.
reject.notFoundGroup: This group no longer exists: somebody has deleted it.
reject.limit: The wall is full: it holds no more than {{max}} notes. Delete one to make room.
reject.limitGroups: A wall holds no more than {{max}} groups. Delete one to make room.
reject.conflict: The note could not be added. Write it again.
reject.invalid: The wall did not take the change. Try again.
reject.phaseGroups: Groups come once the notes are revealed.
reject.phaseClock: The notes are revealed already: the clock is there only while writing is hidden.
reject.staleClock: The clock was changed at the same moment: your step was not taken. It shows what holds now.
reject.staleStep: The wall was in another step at the same moment: your move was not taken. The top of the wall says where it is now.
reject.daySpent: The wall has stored as much today as a wall may in one day: your change was not taken. It goes on at {{time}}.
reject.notAdmin: Only the facilitator can do that.
reject.rateLimit: Those were too many changes at once: the last one was not taken. Wait a moment and make it again.
reject.lost: Too many changes piled up without a connection: the oldest one was taken back.
reject.phaseArrange: Grouping comes once the notes are revealed.
reject.staleUndo: The wall has been grouped anew meanwhile: only the last grouping can be undone. The wall shows what holds now.
reject.applyChanged: The wall changed twice while applying, and the arrangement was not taken. The proposal still stands: try again.
reject.arrangeNothing: There are too few notes to group: the AI needs at least {{min}} that lie in no group made or renamed by hand.
reject.arrangeBudget: The AI’s allowance is used up, for all walls. It goes on {{when}}. Grouping by hand always works.
reject.arrangeBudgetNoTime: The AI’s allowance at Cloudflare is used up, for all walls. The app cannot say when it goes on: in 24 hours at the latest. Grouping by hand always works.
reject.arrangeRuns: The AI has been asked to group this wall {{runs}} times in 24 hours, and more is not possible. It works again {{when}}. Grouping by hand always works.
reject.arrangeFailed: The AI gave no usable answer. Try again, or group by hand.
reject.arrangeUnavailable: No AI is connected to this server. Group by hand.
reject.arrangeNetwork: The request did not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
reject.arrangeTimeout: No answer came from the AI within two minutes, and the waiting has ended. Try again, or group by hand.
reject.arrangeUnknown: Grouping did not work: the server gave an unexpected answer. Try again, or group by hand.
reject.arrangeNothingLeft: Nothing is left of the proposal: its notes were deleted meanwhile, or lie in groups that were made or renamed by hand.
reject.keyRefused: {{provider}} refused the key. Enter it again under “More”: it may be copied incompletely, expired, or not allowed to use this service.
reject.keyRefusedBrowser: {{provider}} refused the key. Enter it again under “More”: it may be copied incompletely, expired, or not allowed to use this service. {{provider}} does not let accounts with “zero data retention” ask from a browser.
reject.keyNoCredit: {{provider}} did not compute: the account has no credit left, or a spending limit is reached. Add credit there or raise the limit. Grouping by hand always works.
reject.keyRateLimited: {{provider}} is taking no further requests right now: too many in a short time, or the service is overloaded. Wait a moment and try again.
reject.keyRejected: {{provider}} turned the request down, not the key. The cause may be the model, the form of the request, or a limit of your account there. Group by hand, or remove the key under “More”: then Cloudflare groups again.
reject.keyDeclined: {{provider}} gave no answer: the model declined the request, for the provider’s own reasons. Group by hand, or remove the key under “More”: then Cloudflare groups again.
reject.keyUnreachable: {{provider}} could not be reached, or the browser was not allowed to read the answer. Check the connection and try again.
reject.keyUnusable: {{provider}} gave no usable answer. Try again, or group by hand.
reject.keyTimeout: After two minutes {{provider}} was not done: the requests were cancelled. Try again, or group by hand.
reject.keyLoad: The part of the app that groups with your key could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.

key.title: Own AI key
key.text: With a key of your own, “Group notes” asks your AI provider straight from this browser, not Cloudflare. The key stays in this tab: after a reload it is gone, and it never reaches the server of {{app}}. What grouping costs is billed by the provider to your account there.
key.line: Notes: {{facts}}. Cost: by the price list about {{cents}} US cents for a wall of 250 notes.

place.eu: in data centers in the EU and EFTA, according to {{provider}}

key.keptLonger: stored there for up to {{days}} days (flagged content longer)

training.no: not used for training, according to {{provider}}
training.account: training depends on your account’s setting there

key.unmeasured: How well {{provider}} groups notes has not been measured yet.
key.replaces: A new key replaces the one that is set.
key.malformed: The key contains spaces or characters that no key has. Copy it again.
key.saidRemoved: Key removed. “Group notes” asks Cloudflare again.
